row.name: Moongate
row.description: Free, source-available iPhone and Android remote for Klipper 3D printers. Full Mainsail/Fluidd UI, live webcam tiles, print controls. Local WiFi when home, automatic Cloudflare tunnel when away - no port forwarding, no static IP, no subscriptions.
